rules.statement: A landlord granting a tenancy in a representative capacity cannot set up the estoppel in a personal capacity.
rules.supporting_quote: He must be treated as though he had dealt with him in that capacity. He has no title to the whole of the property, the rent of which he seeks to recover; he can only rely upon a tenancy by estoppel. But a landlord granting a tenancy in a representative capacity cannot set up the estoppel in a personal capacity.
